clan.name: -*Unity Guild*-
clan.description:
UNITY welcomes active players only with 1M points or above. This is only to show you are already committed to FoE. Please reach out if you are an experienced player starting out in this world. 

We offer;
All levels of GE opened weekly 
Compete in GbG (plat & dime league) 
QI if you wish to participate.
Friendly guild members 
Bonuses from a level 71+ guild. 

Requirements;
MUST participate in GE & GbG to some standard.
MUST communicate with founders/leaders 
MUST be kind and friendly 
MUST have an ARC and/or OBSERVATORY and be willing to level these to a reasonable level. 

If you feel you can meet the small requirements of this amazing guild. 
Please join 😊 
We also welcome friendly visitors.

UNITY welcomes active players only with 1M points or above. This is only to show you are already committed to FoE. Please reach out if you are an experienced player starting out in this world. 

We offer;
All levels of GE opened weekly 
Compete in GbG (plat & dime league) 
QI if you wish to participate.
Friendly guild members 
Bonuses from a level 71+ guild. 

Requirements;
MUST participate in GE & GbG to some standard.
MUST communicate with founders/leaders 
MUST be kind and friendly 
MUST have an ARC and/or OBSERVATORY and be willing to level these to a reasonable level. 

If you feel you can meet the small requirements of this amazing guild. 
Please join 😊 
We also welcome friendly visitors.

clan.name: Canadians
clan.description: In Canada we accept people from all around the world eh.Hi and Welcome to CanadiansWe are a pretty relaxed group; we like to keep the peace eh? So there's not so much in the way of rules per say, rather a mutually beneficial agreement to be fair to each other. And a few explanations about how things work such as: - Fair Trades - are 1:1 for the same Era, 1:2 for ONE lower Era and 2:1 for ONE higher Era. "Even Fairer" trades would offer a little more than necessary like 110 goods for 100 same era, or offering more than one era higher goods (that you happen to have lots of) to get lower era goods you are desparate for, or just to help out. That's when you want to check the box to make it only available to your guildmates.   - In The Mud - or in sticks or muddy all refer to brand new Great Buildings and you should post all new GBs as soon as you build them in "In The Mud for New Great Buildings" thread and everyone should chip in and help build the first few levels to help them on their way.   - We hope everyone aids everyone every day but real life gets in the way sometimes so please try your best.  - And please try to let someone know like a Leader or Founder if you will be away more than a week or you might get the autokick.  - The Donate First Threads - like "DONATE 10 fp GET 10fp Great Buildings" thread means you must donate the required 10FPs to the last one posted FIRST and THEN post yours for someone to donate to.- Sniping - is not allowed in the guild. Putting a small amount like one or two Forge Points in someone's Great Building hoping for a big payback, which is obviously not mutually beneficial, and while it may be ok to try to cheat your weaker neighbours it could start feuds with stronger ones and friends will drop you for it and most guilds have strict policies against sniping your fellow guildies.  - Buildings that help the Guild like the Arc, Atomium and Observatory are, in many guilds, required for entry, as are participation in the Guild Expedition, Guild BattleGrounds and Guild vs Guild Map. We haven't been doing the GVG map and we don't insist on the buildings but we can help get them built if you need. But we would like to see everyone doing some of the Guild Expedition and Guild BattleGrounds because this helps the guild standings a lot and they give great rewards back too.  - If you have any questions just ask in Q & A thread.  - So everyone be nice and try to help out and we all will have fun.  Happy Building!!

clan.name: ️Nova Aurora ☀️
clan.description: Welcome to   NOVA AURORA  -  A New Dawn on the horizon.We are a level 100 guild which offers:- 40% boost for recruitment and heal- 20 fp Research Boost per day- 25% Building RebateWe have active 1.9, 1.92, 1.95 threads.We have a solid core of top fighters who give it their all each and every season.  We welcome all players who enjoy the fight and will jump in at every opportunity.  Always room for that core to grow.Our seasoned players are happy to offer advice, answer questions and help you with any goals you may have set for yourself.  We do have a few must do's but they are fairly straight forward...1. Fair Trades, including respecting the eras.  2. GE, enter into or finish lvl 5. 3. QI – the benefits of playing QI are huge so we encourage everyone to give it their best.  At minimum you must build a settlement and spend some action points to get you on the leader board.  It is expected that you strive to improve your QI ranking.4. Arc lvl 80+ or be prepared to work tirelessly to get it there. Also one other treasury GB – Obs, AI, ATO, Hydra – being levelled consistently.5. GBG Minimum 750 points every season.  1000 is strongly encouraged. 6. Minimum Era - Each applicant considered regardless of Era.  If joining will be a problem for our treasury the applicant must commit to donating the era minimum per day.7. Treasury - Each Era has a minimum daily donations that  members are expected to meet.It's a reasonable amount considering all the event buildings that give TGs.If you're keen to grow your city with us while contributing to NA's growth and success, please make an application.Guild Primary Contacts: Cord, Katia Grim, Frank1e, Grendeth, JTALuckyHISTORY...Nova Aurora is a merger between two historical guilds Sentinels & Prometheus Lair.   Establish in March 2024 but with over 12 years of history & tradition. Sentinels finished 5th in world after GVG finishedPrometheus Lair was established 2021 from a merge between Prometheus Rising and The LairThis physical guild was Est circa 2012 as Prometheus Rising.
